ariadne: assembling relational information across the database network

ariadne is a multi-purpose R package that integrates relational knowledge from various biological databases. It provides tools to navigate the resource graph, find and visualise paths between features and link them across different omics by leveraging the resource graph hosted in the companion package ariadneDB. It is also available in Python with the package ariadnePy and as a web app with the Shiny package ariadneApp.

Example applications:

  • Link across omics types based on prior knowledge (KEGG, UniProt, Rhea, etc.)
  • Stratify microbial features by functional modules (BugSig, Gut Modules, etc.)
  • Translate across different taxonomies (NCBI, SILVA, OTT, etc.)

Installation instructions

The release version can be installed from Bioconductor with:

if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")

BiocManager::install("ariadne")

To access the latest functionality, the development version can be installed with:

if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")

# Initialize Bioconductor devel version
BiocManager::install(version = "devel")

BiocManager::install("ariadne")
